title: region.resume
description: Several games (MULTI_GAME_PLAN §4.3, MG2): release the hold. When the hidden player is not on `to`, the adapter queues the engine's own warp there, but only onto one of this mod's route maps (KB_ROUTE_*) or the saved away cell (story safety, §4.13: towns are entered through the route map's own step script). Answered by act.result{kind:"resume"}; refusals not_ingame, not_idle, busy, bad_target.
